intro.title: Hart County Vehicle Maintenance
intro.description: The Hart County Maintenance Shop maintains and repairs the vehicles and heavy equipment that support county departments and public services.

overview: The Hart County Maintenance Shop is housed in a 6,000 square foot facility. The Shop services and repairs approximately 220 vehicles and pieces of equipment for 15 departments.
The seven-employee operation saves taxpayers money by performing work ranging from routine tire repairs to major equipment overhauls.
rebuild: The Maintenance Shop can extend the useful life of expensive county equipment through major repairs and rebuilds.
One older piece of equipment that would have cost more than $125,000 to replace was rebuilt by the Shop for less than $20,000, extending its service life for many more years.
fabrication: The Shop also operates a welding and fabrication division that can produce custom fabrications for a fraction of the cost of outside services. The department has fabricated and rebuilt fire trucks for the Hart County volunteer fire service.
The Maintenance Shop also supports the County fleet's fueling system, helping county vehicles obtain fuel at a lower cost than local retail stations.
